subject: Next steps & rotating demo windows — proposed schedule

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & rotating demo windows — proposed schedule

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet you and Marco on the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed way forward so we can lock the technical deep dive/demo with the right folks.

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goals: validate latency & cost profile for your batch inference workloads, and review VPC options for protected PHI flows.
- Attendees we discussed: your infra/CTO (Marco), your security contact, and our runtime engineer + solutions lead.

Proposed approach for scheduling: to make it easy across US/EU/APAC teams, we suggest a rotating weekly window so the same team member(s) can host predictable time slots for each region. Example rotation (local times shown):

- Week A (US morning host): 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET (good for West / Central US)
- Week B (EU morning host): 10:00 CET / 09:00 UK (good for London/Frankfurt attendees)
- Week C (APAC morning host): 10:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST (good for Singapore / Sydney)

Concrete dates I can offer for the first three sessions if that helps us commit:
- Week A (US slot): Tue, 20 Oct 2026, 09:00 PT
- Week B (EU slot): Tue, 27 Oct 2026, 10:00 CET
- Week C (APAC slot): Tue, 3 Nov 2026, 10:00 SGT

If it helps, you can pick a single date or we can set the rotation cadence (weekly / biweekly). I attached a short agenda and a security brief stub for your security reviewer.

Quick asks:
1) Which of the three windows works best for Marco and the rest of the team?
2) Any must-have agenda items we should add to the agenda?

Calendly (if you want to self-schedule): https://calendly.com/redwood/sales-demo?month=2026-10

Thanks — happy to adjust.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear recap. Marco and I reviewed the options — the EU morning slot (Tue, 27 Oct 2026, 10:00 CET) is the best fit for our calendar right now.

A couple notes:
- Marco will join but our security lead (Nadia) is only available on Tuesdays/Fridays — so Tue 27 is good.
- We usually keep Thursdays for executive review, so avoiding Thurs is ideal.
- Can you include a short section in the agenda that shows expected token-cost ranges for a 10k-doc batch? That will help our procurement team.

If that date is firm on your side, please send an invite with the recording option on; Marco will forward to Nadia and our infra lead.

Thanks for the details Alyssa — and thanks Steph for the clear options. A couple quick operational notes from the solutions side: 

- For the technical deep dive we'll bring: one runtime engineer (Karthik) and one solutions architect (Ben) to walk through the inference pipeline and quantization options.
- Rotation cadence: we usually recommend starting weekly for the first 3 sessions to capture feedback, then drop to biweekly for steady-state. Weekly gives us better signal on cost/latency tradeoffs across live workloads.
- Backup plan: if Nadia (security) can't make the first session we can run the demo + record the security-specific segment and schedule a 30-min security sync with her the following week.

I added a short note to the agenda (token-cost scenarios). If Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:00 CET works for CareWell, I can route a calendar invite that includes the demo deck link and call recording enabled.

Ben Carter
